ai_summary: Aarti Pharmalabs reported strong Q1 FY27 results, demonstrating significant year-on-year revenue (38.7%) and PAT (65.4%) growth, bolstered by strategic capacity expansions and improved margins post-debottlenecking activities. While aggressive capital expenditure has led to increased borrowings and a notable dip in FY26 ROCE/ROE, the company projects a 15-18% revenue and EBITDA CAGR over the next 3-4 years, signaling confidence in future returns from these investments. Investors should closely monitor the realization of these projected returns and the reversal of the recent profitability ratio declines as new capacities become fully operational.
